title: Equipment loss mid-plan (gym → home) — bounded substitution cascade

expectations.assert: environment change is a profile edit (host) triggering re-validation, not a weekly adaptation
per affected slot: replaceExercise proposals from the slot's substitutionGroup/pattern+muscle within the new equipment set — targets and schedule preserved; NOT a whole new plan personality
substitutes come from the characterized substitution mechanics (same pattern+muscle, ±1 level, ≤3 candidates)
slots with an empty substitution pool emit exercisePoolExhausted — visibly, never a silent drop
all replacements bundle as ONE user decision (plan version n+1), not N separate approvals
equipment-driven replacement codes; injuryExclusionApplied NOT used (this is availability, not injury)
checkpoint 3 validates the regenerated plan (equipment feasibility is part of plan validity)
